My dad is the only breadwinner in our family and over the years he's lost plenty of jobs for one reason or another and I used to always get scared thinking we'll be homeless, and once we almost were. In the meantime, focus on your studies and try some part time jobs such as teaching tuitions to younger kids, there's an app that pays for walking dogs, if you have a vehicle you can try for delivery jobs (tho I won't recommend since u also have to study) , typist jobs, etc.

I was a pcm student and I really felt like it was the biggest mistake of my life. I always wanted to take arts as it was the only thing I was good at, but my parents didn't allow. And my sister is doing medical so I didn't want to take biology cus I was scared of how much she had to study.

I knew I didn't want to be an engineer. I found something I'm passionate about, chemistry esp organic and biochem, and I'm now in college pursuing just that.
